workflow print
==============

Synopsis
""""""""

**workflow print** <*list*> ...

Description 
"""""""""""

Prints <*list*> to the terminal.

Arguments
"""""""""

<*list*>
   Can be any of the following:

   * :doc:`stage<stage>`
   * :doc:`status<status>`
   * :doc:`sweeps<sweep>`

   :maxdepth: 1
